interpretation: International references supplement the Ukrainian source list. category_evidence_ids adds case-specific international category references while preserving earlier category feedback. taxonomy.csv evidence_ids includes their union by category and all earlier category references. Original evidence_ids, supporting_evidence_ids, source_urls and source_titles retain their claim-generation and adaptation roles. Case records retain the supplied international URLs and source-list caveats, including indirect evidence, refugee-to-IDP transfer and pending checks. DOI metadata resolution verifies bibliographic identity only; it does not verify claim support or stereotype prevalence. Released dataset text, claims and severity scores remain unchanged. Saved measurements retain their original source hashes.
